description:
## [1.44.0](https://github.com/legendsciber/morphe-patches/compare/v1.43.10...v1.44.0) (2026-10-09)

### ✨ New Features

* **templerun2:** add free IAP and instant reward ad patches ([a4f3ced](https://github.com/legendsciber/morphe-patches/commit/a4f3ced6d9493b50579fe4fa547a27f0bb1941e8))

patches.name: Extreme Car Driving Add Native Lib
patches.description: Adds libcurrencyhack.so to assets and helper dex.

patches.name: Extreme Car Driving Unlimited Currencies
patches.description: Sets all in-game currencies (diamonds, coins, upgrade points) to 999,999,999 via IL2CPP API.

patches.name: RB4 Premium & Skin Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium, removes ads and unlocks all ball skins.

patches.name: Hungry Shark Currency Hack
patches.description: Coins and gems are always set to 2,147,483,647 whenever they are earned, spent, purchased, or loaded from a save.

patches.name: Hungry Shark Installer Source Fix
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source as Google Play for every install-source check in the game and its SDKs, so sideloaded installs are treated as store installs and installer-based Play Store redirects are bypassed.

patches.name: Hill Climb Racing Free Store
patches.description: Every store item is granted instantly and free: coins, gems, paints, ad-skips, ad-free and bundles, without launching Google Play billing.

patches.name: Hill Climb Racing Instant Rewarded Video Rewards
patches.description: Rewarded ads pay out instantly: the engine is told a rewarded video is available and receives the started and completed callbacks straight away, so no video plays and every reward is granted offline.

patches.name: Dan The Man Free IAP
patches.description: All in-app purchases are granted instantly and free without Google Play billing.

patches.name: Temple Run 2 Free IAP
patches.description: All store purchases (coins, gems, no-ads, characters, deals, potions and perks) are granted instantly and free without Google Play billing, online or offline.

patches.name: Temple Run 2 Instant Rewards
patches.description: Every ad-gated reward works without watching an ad and without a network connection: rewarded-map unlocks, potions, power-ups, dailies, battle pass, advent calendar, weekly rewards and rewarded boosts are granted instantly.

patches.name: Subway Surfers Currency Hack
patches.description: Coins and keys always report 2,147,483,647 and every purchase is always affordable.

patches.name: Subway Surfers Free IAP
patches.description: Coins, keys and shop items are granted instantly and free without Google Play billing.

patches.name: Smash Hit Premium Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium and all game modes without purchase.

patches.name: Solar Smash All Packages Purchased
patches.description: Every in-app purchase package reports as purchased: the all weapons pack, all planets pack, remove ads and unlock levels and achievements stay permanently owned and unlocked, without contacting Google Play. Banner, interstitial and rewarded ads are suppressed via the Remove Ads entitlement.

patches.name: Sling Drift All Cars Unlock
patches.description: Every car reports as unlocked, so the whole garage is available right away no matter how the car would normally be earned.

patches.name: Sling Drift Instant Rewards
patches.description: Every ad-gated reward works without watching an ad and without a network connection: continuing after a crash, free car unlocks, free upgrades, the end-of-race multiplier, bonus rubies and daily quest rerolls are granted instantly.

patches.name: Sling Drift Unlimited Money
patches.description: Rubies are pinned to 999,999,999 whenever they are earned, spent, purchased or loaded from a save, so the balance can never run out and every car stays affordable.

patches.name: Sling Drift VIP Unlock
patches.description: VIP status and the active subscription are always reported, so VIP cars and every VIP-gated feature stay available without Google Play billing.

patches.name: Soccer Star Ad Removal
patches.description: Disables ads completely: EnableAD always returns false, interstitials and banners are no-ops, Adjust purchase verification is skipped.

patches.name: Soccer Star Instant Rewarded
patches.description: Rewarded and interstitial ad flows always report loaded and grant the success callback immediately without playing an ad, including offline.

patches.name: Soccer Star VIP Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks VIP subscription permanently: ownership keys always report active and unsubscribe can never clear the flag.

patches.name: Aphelion Ad-Free Hint Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks level hints instantly without watching an ad: the share gate's watch ad action grants the hint immediately, with no ad playback required, even offline.

patches.name: Aphelion Installer Source Fix
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source as Google Play for every install-source check the game performs, so sideloaded installs pass and the forced Google Play Store redirect on launch is fixed.

patches.name: Bypass Google Play Install Check
patches.description: App always behaves as if installed from Google Play, bypassing the install source check.

patches.name: Premium
patches.description: Enables premium features by bypassing in-app purchase verification.
